contexts.text: Abimelech the king of Gerar = the doctrine of faith. AC 2504. AC 2513. AC 2516. AC 2519. AC 2520. AC 2547. AC 2565. AC 2571. AC 2583. AC 2720:4.
Abimelech = the doctrine of faith looking to rational things. AC 2510, Explained in AC 2540. AC 2581. AC 3365. AC 3391. AC 3393. AC 3447. AC 3448.
Abimelech = doctrine looking to rational things, or what is the same, the rational things of doctrine.
The house of Abimelech = the good of the doctrine of faith.
Abimelech and Phicol = human rational things from scientifics. AC 2720.
Abraham gave flock and herd to Abimelech = Divine goods implanted in rational things of doctrine.
Abimelech and Phicol returned to the land of the Philistines = that still they had no part in doctrine.
They who are being regenerated and are becoming men of the Spiritual Church are meant by Abimelech, that is, they who are in the doctrine of faith, and have regard to truths in knowledges.
(In the highest sense Abimelech represents the Lord as to doctrine that has regard to rational things.) AC 3401.
Abimelech, as king of the Philistines, = doctrine without life.

Abimelech, Ahusath and Phicol = those who are in the literal sense of the Word, and thence in the doctrinal things of faith... These are they who make faith the essential thing, and do not indeed reject charity, but postpone it, thus set doctrine before life... AC 3451. AC 3469.
In the good of truth are they who are here represented by Abimelech. Explained.
These spirits are represented by Abimelech.
Abimelech king of Gerar or of the Philistines = those who place salvation in mere truths without good of life.
